quizGuardRationale: Draft direct pairwise hypotheses from actual full labels and ordinary secondary senses in both directions; no transitive closure or blanket POS exemption.
文芸's literature/arts scope differs from 文献's research-source role; books/documents/reference safeguards do not assert that every book is research literature.
噴水 and 泉 have overlapping English fountain labels but distinct practical defaults. 分数 and 小数 can express one value in distinct notation; no ratio-category clique.
文体 uses actual style/form labels and 文章's non-title style meaning. 分布 compares spreading, not automatically handing out or adoption.
文房具's writing implements are compared against broader tool labels, not all office objects.
文脈 uses actual 前後 context and 事情/状況/次第 circumstances, not all time-order meanings.
分量 compares quantity labels and additionally recorded measurement/weighing; units, net status and monetary amount labels remain independent review hypotheses, not unrestricted Japanese substitution.
分類 uses actual 区分/整理/分ける sorting, not every category or act of distinction. 閉会 compares actual endings/event-closing uses, not automatic cancellation.
平気 compares composure and all-right uses, including actual 良い permission/compromise sense; historical calendar use is excluded.
並行 compares concurrence and actual alongside meanings, not near-simultaneous 前後 or automatic transitive arrangement. 平行's concurrency is explicitly recognized.
平日 is calendar-context dependent; no general everyday-life clique. 兵隊 compares individual soldier and collective troops, not automatic historical 武士.
平凡's ordinary/unremarkable and evaluative labels are direct hypotheses; plainness and boredom are not asserted as necessary properties.

平野 compares exact open-field/plain meanings, not every land or activity field. 凹む uses actual depression, dejection, defeat/yield/loss and recession senses; reflective しんみり is not automatically dejection.
臍 compares center/main-point meanings, not the whole belly. 隔てる compares direct separation; intervals and every cutting action are not automatically synonyms.
